structure: Part 17 read the live-animals `documents` feature folder as it works without JavaScript: `page.js` (id/slug `accompanying-documents`, maturity `agreed`), `controller.js` (439 lines: the four routes GET page, POST page, GET `/status`, GET `/{uploadId}/file`, plus the claim-on-return, remove, retry and continue handlers), `template.njk` (190 lines: guidance block, additional-documents details expander, the add-a-document form inside a `govuk-summary-card` headed "File upload", the added-documents `govukTable`, the refresh fallback link and the save actions), `validate.js` (the stored-list staleness check), `evaluation.js` (the six document leaves bound to the `documents` group), `upload-config.js` (the eight accepted file types, the 50MB cap, the accept attribute and the attachment-type derivation), `test-support.js`, every file under `form/` (`errors.js`, `payload.js`), `contracts/` (`max-documents.js`, `documents-added-anchor.js`, `add-document-anchor.js`, `upload-id.js`, `remove-action.js`, `upload-session.js`), `handlers/` (`claim-upload.js`, `load-page.js`, `add-form-session.js`, `unsaved-claim.js`, `reads/download.js`) and `view-model/` (`render.js`, `rows.js`, `refresh.js`, `fragments/document-type.js`, `fragments/status.js`, `fragments/text.js`) except the co-located `*.test.js`, both copy locales in full, and the three fit specs `fit/entry.fit.spec.js` (2 tests), `fit/guidance.fit.spec.js` (5 tests) and `fit/upload.fit.spec.js` (1,050 lines, 32 tests across nine describes: page, reference validation, type validation, date validation, file validation, oversize validation, continue, saved rows, capacity and accessibility, no-JavaScript, and browser history). It also read, as supporting provenance only, `services/document-types/stub.js` (the 13 document type codes and 8 attachment type codes), `services/document-uploads/claim-contract.js` (reference max length 58 and the allowed-character pattern), `obligations/sections/documents.js` (0..15 documents, which fields are mandatory), `download-content-type.js` (what the file route serves), `scan-poll.js` (the three scan statuses) and the flow's section caption for the documents section. It covers the documents page's route, heading, caption and entry; the guidance and its expander; every field of the add-a-document form with its label, hint, options and rules; every validation message; the uploaded-documents table column by column with the status wording for each state; remove and download; where Continue leads; what the three fit specs prove; the English copy keys these pages use with Welsh key parity; and the upload-session, claim and row-building mechanisms. It leaves the scan-status page, the polling endpoint's client behaviour, `scan/`, `client/` and `fit/scan-status.fit.spec.js` and `fit/drop-zone.fit.spec.js` to part 18.

    journeyId,
